items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

ctx.x: Eddie was bad, he was really bad. He’s the first one of our group that really got a gig, Sissle and Blake hired him. He went to Europe and come back speaking Spanish, and that’s where all the guys in that band had put that in it. But that era, that whole era of seeing all those wonderful people coming from all parts of the United States to Chicago, seeking the better chance for their children. That’s really what they were doing. And here they can get a decent job, and the biggest stockyards in the world in…
